I have successfully fixed the failing test and issue.

### Root Cause
`LRUCache.get()` was simply returning the value from `self._data.get(key, default)` without updating the access order of the key. Therefore, calling `cache.get("a")` did not mark `"a"` as recently used, leaving `"b"` as the least recently used item instead of `"a"`.

### Fix
Updated `LRUCache.get()` so that when an existing key is accessed, it is removed and re-inserted into `self._data` to correctly update its recency (moving it to the most recently used position, i.e. the end of insertion order).

### Files Changed
- `lru.py`
